text: Yes. HTTP/3 runs over QUIC, and QUIC is built on UDP (typically port 443). QUIC reimplements what TCP gave HTTP/2, including reliability, congestion control, and ordered delivery per stream, and integrates TLS 1.3 directly into the handshake. Because it sits on UDP, it avoids TCP's head-of-line blocking across streams and can complete connection setup in fewer round trips.
